_comment: Reviewed network surfaces (non-negotiable #1). audit-network.sh fails on any network-capable call site whose path does not match a 'file' glob here. Every entry needs an ADR reference and a user-toggle note. Empty by default — the app ships with zero egress; features add entries only with an ADR + a settings kill switch.
